title: Brown Rice with Festive Vegetable Pot
subtitle: roasted vegetables in a spiced tomato sauce
description: A colourful pot of eggplant, sweet potato, cauliflower, zucchini and capsicum braised in a spiced tomato sauce, served over soft short-grain brown rice.

steps.text: Cut the eggplant into cubes and salt it. Mix all the vegetables together: eggplant, sweet potato, cauliflower, zucchini, red onions, capsicum, tomatoes and a handful of green beans.
Heat a wide oven-safe pot, add the oil and then all the vegetables, and sear lightly for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend all the sauce ingredients (tomato paste, garlic, brown sugar, salt, cumin, pepper and olive oil) in a food processor. Add 3 cups water and pour over the vegetables so the sauce covers them all.
Bring to the boil, taste the liquid and add salt if needed. Lower the heat, cover and cook for 40 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 170°C. Transfer the covered pot to the oven and bake for 40 minutes. Raise the heat to 220°C and uncover the pot to brown the top.
For the rice: soak the rice for at least 2 hours, then rinse well. Put it in a pot with water to 2 cm above the rice, add 1 tsp salt and bring to the boil.

Lower to the lowest heat, cover and cook for about 1 hour, opening and stirring occasionally, and adding about half a cup of water if it runs dry. When all the water is absorbed the rice will be sticky, so add the sesame oil and the other oil. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 20 minutes.
Serve the vegetables over the rice.
